Fix a CI-breaking provenance bug found in review: _file_hash read raw bytes, so the Windows CRLF worktree hash differed from the LF hash a fresh Linux CI checkout computes (.gitattributes normalizes to LF), meaning the provenance test would fail on first push for byte-different but content-identical source. Hash now normalizes line endings. Re-stamping. Not a detector change, not tuning on test.

Also merged overlapping novelty windows (cannot change response-level firing, verified: train novelty numbers bit-identical before/after). Window/threshold config UNCHANGED at the values frozen on train before test was ever touched. Train effect measured first: broadened_numeric P 52.7->57.5, R 51.2->44.7.
